title: SOLARFOLK MUSIC FESTIVAL
tickerText:
After our sell out debut festival last year we are back with another ripper lineup!
A family friendly music festival in the Nowa Nowa Recreation Reserve with our new solar powered PA system - one of only two of its kind in the country!
Featuring Austin Mackay with full band, Liv Cartledge Duo, Chris Cavill with full band, Demi Casha, Misty Harlowe & Todd Cook and the Rufous Whistlers.
Food vendors, market stalls, kids zone, fire pits and good vibes a plenty. BYO is also welcome - but remember that this a family friendly event so please keep yourselves nice xxx
